qualification: Network virtualizer common logging and reduced diagnostic capabilities
observations: net_virt now emits bounded complete messages through the common log ring. Its serial endpoint, transfer-page mapping and log-drain Call endpoint were removed.
The actual x86 net_virt ELF links with the existing release-silent fallback; no UART service or transfer page is required for logging.
The Spark boot log includes a complete ATTACH client=0 vmm_slot=0 net_pd contract v5 hw=1 record and an RX delivered from net_pd record through the common logger.
ARM guest network, block and console proofs all passed in the full gate.
limitations: The Intel firmware topology does not yet contain the network virtualizer or host NIC. Linking this ELF does not prove Intel network execution.
Network wakeups, Intel host NIC integration and Linux x86 network qualification remain outstanding.
Canonical integration, Debian acceptance, GUI qualification and the v0.4 release remain incomplete.
